description: Source data classes for the Home screen in an Android TV frontend application, defining models such as navigation items, progress indicators, content cards, hero items, and rail sections.

classes.name: NavItem
classes.description: Represents a top navigation item, e.g., 'Inicio', 'Películas'.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Represents a progress indicator with current and total, including a ratio property.

classes.name: CardItem
classes.description: Represents a single content card in a rail, with optional image resource ID or URL, and optional progress.

classes.name: HeroItem
classes.description: Represents a large hero item on the Home screen, with optional image resource ID or URL.

classes.name: RailSection
classes.description: Represents a horizontally scrollable rail with a title and a list of CardItems.

methods.name: Progress.ratio
methods.description: Calculates the ratio of current to total progress, handling division by zero.
